coordinate_semantics.name: sampled-token-coordinate left/right mirror
coordinate_semantics.window_permutation: Reversing sagittal K order together with position merely permutes tokens. The eval Transformer/Attention is permutation equivariant/invariant apart from floating reduction order, so sorting is not required.
coordinate_semantics.native_grid_contract: Artificial audit confirms c[::-1]==native_depth-1-c for released window_centres and every native depth3..64 at k16/k24. Thus sagittal token reversal is consistent with native mirrored-grid centres in the qualified case. Other grids can differ at banker's half ties (depth4/k3 counterexample). Position reflection retains float32 rounding tolerance.
coordinate_semantics.channel_normalization: ImageNet mean/std differ between channels. Reverse uint8 slice channels before normalization; reversing normalized channels is not equivalent.

released_training_augmentation_audit.conclusion: Mirror is a test-time hypothesis, not demonstrated training-supported augmentation.
